investigation_notes.Description: An unusually large volume of SharePoint downloads (300 files) was observed for the user, which exceeds the 24-hour baseline of 0 and was performed with an automated Python/aiohttp user agent. Sample files include business-sensitive datasets (orders, contacts, inventory) and the account lookup returned no internal match, increasing the likelihood of either an account compromise or an unauthorized automated integration. The source IP has a low abuse score but the combination of automation, zero baseline, and the sensitivity/volume of data supports escalation and further investigation, so this alert is classified as high priority.
